title: Q0 Remaining Open Work Classification and Bounded Queue
purpose: Determine the substantive Q0 governance work that remains after patch-local completion and dependency repair, without reopening completed Q0 patches or promoting the intentionally transitional global inventory patch.
summary: This patch creates a deterministic remaining-open-work inventory and prioritized bounded next-work queue. It records one remaining patch-002 completion gate blocked on the global inventory and eleven legacy Q0 queue items that are now either neutralized by later governance boundary enforcement or obsolete queue residue.

core_rule.statement: Historical patch cleanup, patch-local completion, dependency-chain health, and Q0 program completion must be treated as distinct conditions. Completed Q0 patches 007 through 012 are not reopened without contradictory evidence, and PATCH_GOVERNANCE_GLOBAL_INVENTORY_002 remains intentionally PARTIAL until its own completion gate is satisfied.

success_criteria: Every currently known remaining Q0 item is represented exactly once in the inventory.
No completed Q0 patch from 007 through 012 is reopened without contradictory evidence.
PATCH_GOVERNANCE_GLOBAL_INVENTORY_002 remains PARTIAL with authority effect NONE.
The next bounded work queue prioritizes executable neutralized or residue closures ahead of blocked global inventory work.
governance_notes: This patch is analysis-only and does not resolve ambiguity items directly.
This patch preserves the full-project-validation suspension.
This patch does not allocate future patch numbers for the queued follow-on items.
